description: This file defines a 'Header' component for a furniture shopping application's front-end, utilizing the Lightning.js framework. It manages display elements such as the title, navigation buttons ('Home' and 'Cart'), hover interactions, and styling based on a theme.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A Lightning.js component implementing the application's header UI with navigation and styling features.

methods.name: goHome
methods.description: Navigates to the home route when the 'Home' button is activated.

methods.name: goCart
methods.description: Navigates to the cart page when the 'Cart' button is activated.
